name: {n}P_TRUCKS_ONLY_GREEN_TALL
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R5-SA166 225 x 300 (2015, 1:5), R25, green on white, no border. Time numeral ('varies', dashed box 70 wide measured, numeral centred in it) + 25 gap + P 100 E (81), the pair centred ('=' margins), 15 from the top. TRUCKS 35 D baseline 180 (115 + 65), ink 172 (26/172/27); ONLY 35 D baseline 235, ink 119 (53/119/53). Arrow centre line 40 below (y 275), 25 from the bottom. The sheet gives no example time ('X P Trucks Only'): generated at 1P and 2P — not confirmed against SA practice. Arrows are the AS 1743 R5-14 (double, 155 x 32) and R5-16 (single, 125 x 32) open-chevron arrows the sheet cites, drawn as polygons with the national dimensions (shaft 12, head 42 long x 32 wide, barbs 12 thick).
